name: vault-kit
description: Operational tools for a Claude-Code markdown knowledge vault: rules-based audit (linter + judge), a curated-feed triage flow, and audience personas.

plugins.name: vault-audit
plugins.description: Audit a Claude-Code markdown knowledge vault against its own declared rules: a deterministic fixer + a judgment reviewer, each in an isolated git worktree.

plugins.name: vault-feed
plugins.description: Feed a Claude-Code knowledge vault: fetch curated feeds, filter each item for relevance to your stack, and triage the keepers into a dispositioned backlog. A scout (pull + significance filter) + a triager (batch disposition).

plugins.name: vault-persona
plugins.description: Switch your assistant's voice for a target audience. A persona is a markdown file, so adding one means writing a file rather than editing a command. Ships executive / non-technical / peer starters.
